title: Floor 0 — Part 13: The Monster at the Top

lines.text: I pushed the monster down. Why did the lights come *back?*
lines.style: Young man, fast and breathless, shocked, no pauses, the question shot out sharp.

lines.text: Floor by floor, the whole shaft lit up below *me.*
lines.style: Young man, quick, awed and scared, rising.

lines.text: Then he hit the bottom. And he *laughed.*
lines.style: Young man, tense whisper, horrified on the last word.

lines.text: I looked at my hands. They were getting *longer.*
lines.style: Young man, slow terrified whisper, disbelief.
Young man, terrified whisper, fast, the last word breathed out.

lines.text: The building needs a monster. Now it's *me.*
lines.style: Young man, quick shocked whisper, no pauses between words, the last word dropped heavy.

lines.text: Stay and keep their lights on... or save *myself?*
lines.style: Young man, fast and desperate, no pauses, torn between two choices.
Young man, urgent and direct, straight to the viewer, short.
